blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police said that police did not disperse protesters in Cebu, saying they only attempted to extinguish the fire set by rallyists, who were protesting against the visit of United States President Donald Trump and the proposed Pax Silica initiative. “Hindi po natin sila dinisperse.
